title: EuroZig
content_html:
Hello Europe!

Announcing EuroZig!

EuroZig is a community of Zig enthusiasts. Our mission is to grow and support the European Zig community.

our initiatives →

Hosting Conferences and Workshops

We organize conferences, workshops, and Zig Days, and support others in organizing them. Our first conference will be Zigtoberfest 2027.

Supporting the Zig Ecosystem

We aim to support important projects in the Zig ecosystem by applying for grants.

join us →

Join the Mailing list!

We’re currently registering as a German non-profit (e.V.) and are not yet ready to accept members. If you want to be amongst the first to join, you can attend our founding meeting or sign up to the mailing list here:


By signing up to the list, you are agreeing to us storing your name and e-mail address.

你好欧洲！

宣布 EuroZig！

EuroZig 是 Zig 爱好者的社区。 我们的使命是发展和支持欧洲 Zig 社区。

我们的举措 →

举办会议和研讨会

我们组织会议、研讨会和 Zig Days，并支持其他人组织这些活动。 我们的第一次会议是 Zigtoberfest 2027。

支持 Zig 生态系统

我们的目标是通过申请赠款来支持 Zig 生态系统中的重要项目。

加入我们 →

加入邮件列表！

我们目前正在注册为德国非营利组织 (e.V.) 尚未准备好接受会员。 如果您想成为第一批加入者，您可以参加我们的成立会议或在此处注册邮件列表：

注册该列表即表示您同意我们存储您的姓名和电子邮件地址。
